purpose: Seed registry for nationwide observed EV charging-session acquisition. Candidate status does not imply licensing, access, or site-level session availability.

national_candidates.name: Joint Office EV-ChART
national_candidates.notes: Quarterly charging-session data are collected for federally funded infrastructure. Raw portal access is limited to funding recipients/authorized parties; public outputs are aggregated/anonymized. Hunt state recipient publications and public reports, not restricted raw records.

national_candidates.name: DOE Livewire / EV WATTS
national_candidates.notes: Nationwide real-world EVSE dataset and analytics include sessions, utilization and energy. Verify current downloadable geographic resolution and reuse terms before ingest.

national_candidates.name: California Energy Commission funded-project reporting
national_candidates.notes: CEC-funded projects submit detailed utilization/session data. Individual-charger utilization may be confidential, but public grant/project reports can contain publishable site/project aggregates.

national_candidates.name: Stable Auto
national_candidates.notes: Markets nationwide utilization intelligence based on real charging operating data. Requires commercial evaluation and explicit purchasing authority before any paid integration.

national_candidates.name: AFDC charging-network directory
national_candidates.notes: Strong national inventory/network directory for identifying operators and station IDs. Inventory is not session telemetry and must never be promoted to observed usage.

national_candidates.name: Seattle SDOT EVCROW Evaluation Report
national_candidates.notes: Official monthly observed sessions and kWh for two DC fast chargers on the 2500 block of 16th Ave S. Coordinate is a block-level anchor, not exact charger GPS.

national_candidates.name: Austin Energy FY2026 Q1 EV Charging Network
national_candidates.notes: Observed network session totals are useful market context but are not site-resolved and do not satisfy a local RIVET session badge.

national_candidates.name: PennDOT NEVI public reporting
national_candidates.notes: Public NEVI session totals are statewide/network aggregate evidence, not coordinate-resolved site sessions.

national_candidates.name: ACN-Data / ACN-Data Static
national_candidates.notes: Current ACN terms are educational/research only. 81 imported reservoir rows were set to confidence 0 and excluded from commercial RIVET coverage.

national_candidates.name: CHARGED Los Angeles
national_candidates.notes: MIT-licensed city-scale dataset has site coordinates and hourly kWh/duration, but volume is energy, not session count. Never promote it to observed sessions.

national_candidates.name: City of Evanston EV charging usage (legacy nx7w-jb8v)
national_candidates.notes: Official metadata confirms monthly sessions, ports, energy and unique drivers for six city-owned ChargePoint stations, Jan 2016-Aug 2017. Legacy Socrata endpoint is retired; actual row values/current reuse path still need recovery before ingest.

verified_spatial_families.name: Town of Cary EV charging sessions

quarantine_policy.research_only_sources: confidence_pct=0 and QUARANTINED_* schema marker until commercial reuse rights are independently verified
quarantine_policy.modeled_or_energy_only: may support demand context but never populate charging_sessions_count
quarantine_policy.non_site_aggregates: may support market context but never satisfy local observed-session coverage
